Precision Hits grant one stack of 'Charged With Blight'. Each stack grants ? Stability and ? Reload Speed, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.

At 10 stacks, hold [Reload] to load a 'Taken Blight'. Animation speed is scaled by reload stat. Entering this mode immediately triggers the 105 HP heal and health regeneration.

Taken Blight deals <pve 220 /> <pvp [113] /> <arc/>Arc Damage on direct impact with a poisoning field around it that inflicts Corruption and applies <arc/>Blind in a ? meter radius. Corruption deals <pve 27 /> <pvp [0.375] /> <kinetic/>Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds for <pve 3.5 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds.

Any target hit by the Blight takes 50% increased damage from all <yellow Weapons of Sorrow /> for 5 seconds.

Blight can benefit from the final round damage bonus.
